entries.label: Smith Street lobby
entries.note: On Smith Street: a granite lobby with a desk and a lift bank zoned by floor.

entries.label: Tunnel concourse
entries.note: The downtown pedestrian tunnel enters at the concourse below the north side. Its shutters close at 6 pm.

entries.label: Loading dock
entries.note: Two bays off the service drive, shared with the hotel next door. A guard logs every truck.

entries.label: Skybridge to garage
entries.note: A skybridge on the third floor to the parking garage across the street; badge readers at both ends.

entries.label: Roof hatch
entries.note: Between the window-washing davits. The hatch opens onto the mechanical floor.
